reviews.title: Subscription
reviews.text: I downloaded this app and i was automatically debited. I uninstalled this app immediately and two months later they still try to debit my account. Please stop these debit orders, they are messed up my bank account.
reviews.reply:
Hello! This situation may occur if you have downloaded the app before and have used a free trial before. Then, when you reinstall the application and start a free trial again, you will be automatically charged for the first week, because there is no second free trial. To cancel your subscription: 
On your iPhone, open Settings → [your name] → Subscriptions. When doing this, please make sure to open your phone's settings, not the settings inside the Nebula application.

There you will see a list of all active and expired subscriptions. When you tap on a subscription from the list, you can choose a different subscription option or tap Cancel Subscription. 
 
If you don’t see Cancel Subscription, the subscription is already canceled and won't renew.

Here's a more detailed guide on that from Apple: 
https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
